name: ScatterText
description: Letters start scattered at seeded random positions, rotations, and scales and fly together into the headline with eased, staggered motion; on hover they burst apart again and reassemble when the pointer leaves.
a11yNotes: The text is read once from a visually hidden span; the scattered letters are aria-hidden. Scatter positions come from a seeded PRNG so server and client markup match. The hover scatter is decorative only. Under prefers-reduced-motion the letters render assembled with no transitions and hover does nothing.

propsApi.name: text
propsApi.description: Text whose letters assemble from scattered positions.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Duration of each letter's flight in seconds.

propsApi.name: ease
propsApi.description: GSAP-style ease name (sampled into a CSS linear() easing).

propsApi.name: stagger
propsApi.description: Delay between consecutive letters in seconds.

propsApi.name: staggerFrom
propsApi.description: Where the stagger wave starts from.

propsApi.name: scatterOnHover
propsApi.description: Scatter the letters again while hovered and reassemble on leave.

propsApi.name: seed
propsApi.description: Seed for the deterministic scatter layout.

propsApi.name: color
propsApi.description: Text color (defaults to the theme foreground).

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element (CSS variables included).
